text_block_list.text:
Whether her prayers reached the heavens or 
not, Matikanefukukitaru seized the 
victory.

Just like before the race, she worries 
about her, thinking she is consumed by 
fortune and acting like a different 
person.

Upon hearing Silence Suzuka's words, 
Matikanefukukitaru comes back to her 
senses.

Realizing she had done nothing on her own 
and only relied on luck, she froze in 
place, questioning if she could truly call 
this a victory.
